name: Meta Project Anthem - Phase 2
additional_info: Phase 2 rezoning application for ~375 acres near E 11th St and S 193rd E Ave withdrawn by Atmoss LLC Mar 31 2026, days after Tulsa City Council unanimously passed a 9-month moratorium on new data centers. Phase 2 was exempted from the moratorium — Atmoss withdrew anyway, citing it is 'exploring options.' Future Phase 2 remains possible per city officials. Tenant (Meta) confirmed for Phase 1 only. [Stage updated 2026-06-22: Oklahoma City Council approved a moratorium on new data centers, affecting projects like Meta Project Anthem - Phase 2.]
source: NewsOn6 (2026-03-30) | Data Center Dynamics (2026-03-31) | STRisker (2026-03-31) | City of OKC (2026-04-21)
address: Near E 11th St and S 193rd E Ave, east Tulsa, OK

name: Google Stillwater Data Center
additional_info: Up to 6 phases authorized (phases 1-2 currently negotiated with city). Google's second OK campus. ~350-400 acres acquired from State via Commission of the Land Office. Up to 6 phases authorized; first 2 negotiated. ~30 employees/phase. AI-focused. OG&E ESA confirmed May 2026 (Google pays 100% grid connection). Projected water usage 2.7M gal/day per HB 3724 testimony. Part of Google's $9B OK expansion. OG&E powering three new OK DCs (2 Muskogee + Stillwater) under May 2026 announcement.
source: Oklahoma Business Voice (2025-03-13) | OG&E / Daily Energy Insider (2026-05-08)
address: Near Perkins Road and Richmond Road, Stillwater, Payne County, OK 74078
transmission_upgrades.description: OG&E grid connection costs 100% paid by Google; new substations and transmission infrastructure required.

name: Google Sand Springs (Project Spring)
additional_info: Developer: White Rose Partners; end user confirmed as Google (DCD Mar 2026). ~827 acres near N Hwy 97 & Rock School Rd, Sand Springs. Land annexed Jun 2025 — lawsuit ongoing from Project Sand Springs Alliance alleging illegal annexation. Council approved Mar 31 2026. PSO to supply via distant generation facilities. Under Tulsa County jurisdiction (not subject to Tulsa city moratorium).
address: Near N Hwy 97 & Rock School Rd, Sand Springs, Tulsa County, OK
transmission_upgrades.description: PSO transmission from distant generation facilities.

name: Google Muskogee County - Summit Campus
additional_info: One of two Google Muskogee County campuses announced Nov 2025 as part of $9B OK expansion. Near Summit, Muskogee County. Google signed two PPAs: 600 MW of new clean energy (Rush Springs Solar + High Spring Solar, operated by NextEra in Stephens and Muskogee Counties). OG&E ESA: Google pays 100% of grid connection costs. Construction timeline not released.
source: Google / Port Muskogee (2025-11-20) | Daily Energy Insider (2026-05-08)
address: Near Summit, Muskogee County, OK
transmission_upgrades.description: OG&E grid connection 100% paid by Google.

name: Google Muskogee County - Council Hill Campus
additional_info: Second of two Google Muskogee County campuses announced Nov 2025. Near Council Hill, Muskogee County. Low-water design (~20,000 gal/day vs Pryor ~3M). Muskogee Rural Water District #3 signed agreement; Google pays 100% of water district infrastructure upgrades. Air-cooled system. OG&E ESA: Google pays 100% of grid connection costs. High Spring Solar PPA (NextEra, Muskogee County) supplies clean energy.
address: Northeast of Council Hill, Muskogee County, OK
transmission_upgrades.description: OG&E grid connection 100% paid by Google.

name: Beale Infrastructure Project Clydesdale (Owasso)
additional_info: Groundbreaking Oct 30 2025. 400-506 acres unincorporated Tulsa County west of Owasso. 4 phases/7-year buildout; each phase ~200,000 sqft. Unanimously approved by Tulsa County Commissioners Sep 2025. PSO installing new substation + 3 miles distribution lines. Washington County Rural Water District #3 water upgrades. Tenant not publicly disclosed. $2M/yr property tax to county/schools. Exempt from Tulsa city moratorium (outside city limits).
address: N of E 76th St N, E of N Yale Ave, S of E 86th St N, W of N Sheridan Rd, Tulsa County, OK (near Owasso)
transmission_upgrades.description: New PSO substation + 3 miles distribution lines; water district infrastructure upgrades.

name: Beale Infrastructure Project Atlas (Coweta)
additional_info: CANCELLED: Beale withdrew rezoning application Mar 31 2026 following January 2026 rezoning denial by Coweta city council and community opposition. City also discovered fraudulent support emails in apparent astroturfing attempt. Air-cooled/dry system had been announced after water concerns. Client described as 'one of the major US tech giants.' Address: 16192 Highway 51B, south of Coweta.
address: 16192 Highway 51B, south of Coweta, east of Highway 72, Wagoner County, OK

name: Beale Infrastructure Project Mustang (Claremore)
additional_info: Proposed at Claremore Industrial Park. Public hearings May 4 and May 2026 at Claremore City Hall. Community concerns about water and transparency. Beale is still pursuing despite cancellation of Project Atlas (Coweta) and withdrawal from Owasso Phase 2.
address: Claremore Industrial Park, Claremore, Rogers County, OK

name: Gamma Resources - Yukon
additional_info: Proposed near I-40, Yukon. Stalled; zoning hearings deferred twice due to community opposition.

address: Near Redbud power plant, Luther, Oklahoma County, OK

name: EGA / Century Aluminum Inola Smelter
additional_info: $4B aluminum smelter — first new US primary smelter since 1980. 750,000 MT/yr. 1 GW PSO load (matches OCC Docket 2025-000064 single customer >1,000 MW disclosure). EGA 60% / Century 40% JV. Bechtel preparatory engineering Feb 2026. $275M+ state incentives. PSO acquired 795 MW Green Country gas plant partly to serve this. Construction start late 2026, production by decade's end.
source: Oklahoma Dept of Commerce (2026-01-27) | Oklahoma Corp. Commission Docket 2025-000064
address: Tulsa Port of Inola, Inola, Rogers County, OK 74036
transmission_upgrades.description: PSO building 1,299 MW new generation to serve large loads.

name: Google Nebraska Mega Campus (undisclosed)
additional_info: Proposed 1,000-3,000 MW. Tenaska (Omaha-based) would operate privately-built utility-scale natural gas plant. Tallgrass would supply gas. Carbon capture planned. Land options acquired in Gage, Lancaster, Otoe, and Cass Counties (SE Nebraska) per Voice News of SE Nebraska. Governor's bill would allow >1,000 MW private generation for large industrial customers. Location not confirmed; MW null per rules (1,000-3,000 MW is Yale economist estimate, not utility filing).

name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale)
additional_info: Phase 2 under construction, ready mid-2026. 150 MW critical IT load leased to CoreWeave. Part of $7B, ~15-year lease agreement.
address: Near Ellendale, Dickey County, ND 58436

name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale)
additional_info: Phase 3: 150 MW. CoreWeave holds option (not yet contracted). Funded by $300M Goldman Sachs bridge loan (May 4 2026). Campus designed for 400 MW total critical IT load. 1+ GW utility capacity under load study.
source: Applied Digital Press Release (2026-05-04) | Applied Digital / CoreWeave (2025-06-02)
address: Near Ellendale, Dickey County, ND 58436

name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 2 (Harwood)
transmission_utility: Montana-Dakota Utilities (MDU) / Cass County Electric Cooperative
additional_info: $3B, 280 MW AI factory north of Fargo. Groundbreaking Sept 2025. Partial ops 2026, full 2027. 200+ permanent jobs. In advanced negotiations with US investment-grade hyperscaler.
address: Near Harwood, Cass County, ND (north of Fargo)
transmission_upgrades.description: Minnkota Power and Cass County Electric infrastructure upgrades.

name: Gemini Data Center SD (Sioux Falls)
developer: Gemini Capital / Gemini Data Center SD LLC
additional_info: 164-acre site south of Rice St and east of Veterans Pkwy, Sioux Falls. Land acquired from Xcel Energy late 2023 (near Split Rock substation and Angus Anson power station). Council approved rezoning Jan 9 2026 (heavy opposition). Pursuing hyperscale or AI tenant. SD Legislature rejected data center tax incentive Mar 2026; Gemini says plans 'unchanged,' pursuing alternatives via Governor's Office of Economic Development.
address: South of Rice Street and east of Veterans Parkway, Sioux Falls, Minnehaha County, SD

name: Applied Digital Deuel County (Toronto)
additional_info: $5B, 430 MW, two buildings ~907,500 sqft each. East of Toronto, near Otter Tail Power transmission lines and Astoria gas plant. Paused after SD Legislature rejected sales tax exemption Mar 2026. No land purchased, no zoning filed. Monitoring elections. 200 permanent jobs projected. Total investment impact potentially $10-16B.
address: East of Toronto, Deuel County, SD 57268

name: Beale Infrastructure De Soto Campus
additional_info: First hyperscale DC announced in Kansas. $3.1B full buildout; 4 buildings, 1M+ sqft. Groundbreaking May 2026. Near Panasonic EV battery plant (old Flint Commerce Center site), De Soto off Kansas Hwy 10. First building complete by end of 2027. Private on-site substations + new Evergy substation. Closed-loop cooling (~20,000 gal/day). Required to use Kansas LLPS rate plan (applies to customers expecting >100 MW demand / ≥75 MW in any month per KCC — De Soto city FAQ confirms project meets these thresholds). Full buildout now planned at 2.9M sqft (expanded from original 1.14M sqft). Codename: Mount Sunflower Properties LLC (Beale shell company).
address: Near Panasonic EV battery plant, De Soto, Johnson County, KS (off Kansas Hwy 10)
transmission_upgrades.description: New Evergy substation + private on-site substations.

name: Beale Infrastructure Gardner Campus
additional_info: CANCELLED: Beale withdrew application May 7 2026 after city of Gardner communicated no incentives would be granted. 300-acre campus at NW corner of 103rd St & Edgerton Rd, eastern Gardner. 200 residents and 3 counties opposed. Second Johnson County withdrawal in 6 months. Bullock Capital also withdrew Spring Hill proposal ~3 months earlier.
address: NW corner of 103rd Street and Edgerton Road, eastern Gardner, Johnson County, KS

name: Project Bluestem (Tonganoxie)
additional_info: Cloverleaf Infrastructure (Houston). Conceptual as of May 2026. 1.2 GW target (per Cloverleaf rep; per LJW article); 600 MW cited in some earlier reports — 1.2 GW is later Cloverleaf figure. Near Tonganoxie Business Park, 24 Hwy & Kansas Ave. Cloverleaf works with Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI — no confirmed tenant. Kansas Senate Bill 98 driving interest. Opposition group 'Tongie Data Center WatchDog Group' formed; petition for 18-month moratorium circulating. Leavenworth County Commission engaged Apr 2026.
address: Near Tonganoxie Business Park, 24 Highway and Kansas Avenue, Tonganoxie, Leavenworth County, KS

additional_info: 116-acre campus. Developer states 50-150 MW target capacity. $900M-$1.1B estimated investment. Miami County, KS. Evergy utility. MW range from datacentermap.com — not a utility filing; left null per data quality rules. Range noted here.
address: Osawatomie area, Miami County, KS

address: Kansas City, Wyandotte County, KS

additional_info: CANCELLED: 316-acre facility at 191st St and Renner Rd, Spring Hill, withdrew application ~March 2026. Second Johnson County cancellation. Near proposed Beale Gardner site.
address: 191st Street and Renner Road, Spring Hill, Johnson County, KS

name: Teton Digital Project Trinity (Tioga)

Liquid-cooled (quieter than air-cooled). Located 8 miles south of Tioga on 25 acres of 80-acre parcel. Williams County Commissioners approved conditional use permit application Feb 18 2025. Teton Digital funding all grid upgrades. $200M financing being raised (including server costs). Company also has projects in TX, MO, Canada.
source: Data Center Dynamics (2025-04) | KFYR TV (2025-02-18) | New Project Media (2025-04-06)
address: 8 miles south of Tioga, Dry Fork Township, Williams County, ND
